_comment: macOS: the display and the GPU, as on iPadOS one kext (meta todo/macos-bringup.md). The display, as a virtual Mac's: package/macos/DroidVMDisplay.cpp (macOS-DroidVM's, 9db2f6f) is an IOMobileFramebufferLegacy of the collection's IOMobileGraphicsFamily published as AppleParavirtDisplay on an AppleParavirtGPU nub of /arm-io/display (compatible paravirtualizedgraphics,gpu: IOMobileFramebuffer.framework waits for DisplayPortCount framebuffers of such services; the collection has no Apple AppleParavirtGPU); swaps go to the virtio GPU's scanout (DroidVMVirtioGpu.cpp, heap slots) or, without it, are copied to the boot framebuffer; package/macos/IOMobileFramebufferABI.h is the 26A434 classes' ABI. The GPU: build-droidvm-gpu.py's NativeAdreno parts and DroidVMGpu.cpp (DROIDVM_GPU_MACOS), whose attach publishes NativeAdreno and the Metal accelerator, package/macos/DroidVMAccelerator.cpp's AGXAccelerator, an IOGraphicsFamily IOAccelerator; DroidVMVirtioGpu3D.cpp serves its 3D. The linker checks the display's and the accelerator's vtables against the family classes.
